proposals.evidence: DEDR 5381 records Tamil vāṉam/māṉam, Malayalam vānam/mānam, Kota vānm, Toda pōn and Kannada bāna sky. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
